entities.name: Query Nnr enzyme
observations: 499 aa soluble protein; predicted molecular mass 51.16 kDa and pI 6.09.
Contains YjeF_N domain PF03853.22 at residues 34–192 and Carb_kinase domain PF01256.23 at residues 250–483.
Shows 39.8–43.8% identity over 96.2–99.0% coverage to reviewed bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme Nnr homologs.
Likely binds one potassium ion per subunit based on conserved homolog annotations.

entities.name: Bifunctional Nnr
observations: Catalyzes NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration of the S-form of NAD(P)HX.
Repairs hydrated NADH/NADPH by converting NAD(P)HX back to NAD(P)H/NADPH; ADP is converted to AMP and phosphate during dehydration.
Curated homologs carry EC 5.1.99.6 and EC 4.2.1.136 and GO terms for NAD(P)HX epimerase and ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX repair reactions
observations: ADP-dependent dehydration: (6S)-NADHX + ADP = NADH + AMP + phosphate + H+; analogous reaction converts (6S)-NADPHX to NADPH.

entities.name: Potassium cofactor
observations: Reviewed Nnr homolog annotations state that one K+ ion is bound per subunit; this is an annotation-based cofactor assignment, not a direct assay of the query sequence.
